speaker: witness
text: I was in the first aisle, the snack one on the left, looking at the chips.

speaker: witness
text: A guy came in the front door and went straight up to the counter. The clerk was behind the till.

speaker: witness
text: He said something to the clerk, I couldn't hear what at first.

speaker: witness
text: Then he got loud. 'Open it, open it.' Like that.

speaker: witness
text: He had a knife. A kitchen knife, maybe eight inches. He pulled it out of his jacket.

speaker: witness
text: I saw his face clearly. White guy, thirties, dark hoodie.

speaker: witness
text: He shoved the clerk, hard, and the clerk went down behind the counter.

speaker: witness
text: I got down. I crouched behind the shelf.

speaker: witness
text: Then he ran out the front, same way he came in.

speaker: witness
text: The whole thing was maybe twenty, thirty seconds.
